[[{{PAGENAME}}]] is the blacksmith of the [[village]]. He is located southeast of the [[The Dead Horse|tavern]]. He trades metal and metalworking products. He will refuse to speak with you until you complete a [[Quests|quest]] for [[Horadric]] and bring a letter to him.

After you reach {{Happiness|10}} with him you can ask about [[Mining|ore deposits]] and he will tell you that he used to harvest most of his [[iron ore]] from the [[swamp]] before the [[stone bridge]] leading to it was broken.  Oddly, Krezvold’s house will say that you need to have 80{{Happiness}} to come in, but it is impossible to get Krezvold higher than 20.  

When progressing through the DLC [[Stranger sins]], there is a possibility to receive [[Damask sword with gem]] from Krezvold as you walk out of [[Sweet Home]]. He will come to you and give you the sword in hurry saying that one of his clients asked him to melt it but he didn't and now a crime was committed in [[the Town]] using this same sword. 

== Quests ==
===Kill Slimes===
After delivering [[Horadric|Horadric's]] letter to {{PAGENAME}} and receiving {{Happiness|10}} with {{PAGENAME}}, he will ask you to kill some [[slime|slimes]] at the back of his house. To do this he gives you a broken {{Item|rusty sword}}, {{Item|energy potion|2}}, and a {{Item|whetstone}}. You have to use the whetstone to repair the sword at the [[grindstone]] (next to his house) and use it to kill the slimes. Afterwards you need to bring the {{Item|green jelly}} back to {{PAGENAME}} and receive {{item|Simple iron parts|5}}. When this quest is completed you will have the ability to create [[green jelly (food)|green]] and [[red jelly]]. You will also be able to trade with {{PAGENAME}}.

At {{Happiness|10}} you are able to ask him where to find metal ore. {{PAGENAME}} will tell you that you can find metal ore in the [[swamp]] that's located west, across the river. You also unlock the furnace recipe, you can create [[iron ingot]]s and you are able to gather [[iron ore]].

===Purchasing===
*Will not buy back the [[whetstone]], [[cauldron]], [[steel sword]], or any chisels.
*The condition of tools will not affect price or subsequent cost. <i>(even 0%)</i>
*Will not buy related oddities, such as [[metal scrap]] or [[bloody nails]].
*Will not buy any weapons or armor, except for the [[rusty sword]].
*Will not buy any high-tier tools, except for the [[shovel II]]. <i>(see [[Cory#Trading|Cory]] and [[Tress#Trading|Tress]])</i>
